CREATE TABLE audit_events (
	actor_id VARCHAR(36), 
	target_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	before JSON NOT NULL, 
	after JSON NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	public BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	report_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (code)
)

CREATE TABLE datasets (
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	license VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	synthetic BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	checksum VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name, version)
)

CREATE TABLE leaderboard_snapshots (
	scope VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	entries JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE outbox (
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	dedupe_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	available_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	dispatched_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	error VARCHAR, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (dedupe_key)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	identity_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	handle VARCHAR(32), 
	display_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320), 
	merged_into VARCHAR(36), 
	home_area_id VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (identity_type in ('guest','registered')), 
	CHECK (role in ('citizen','moderator','admin')), 
	UNIQUE (handle), 
	FOREIGN KEY(merged_into) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE administrative_areas (
	dataset_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	area_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	boundary geometry(MULTIPOLYGON,4326) NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	effective_from VARCHAR, 
	effective_to VARCHAR, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (dataset_id, code, area_type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(dataset_id) REFERENCES datasets (id)
)
CREATE INDEX idx_administrative_areas_boundary ON administrative_areas USING gist (boundary)

CREATE TABLE appeals (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	decision TEXT, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE auth_identities (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (provider, subject), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE civic_actions (
	created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	organizer VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	location_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	location geography(POINT,4326) NOT NULL, 
	starts_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	ends_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	capacity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	demo BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (capacity > 0), 
	CHECK (ends_at > starts_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX idx_civic_actions_location ON civic_actions USING gist (location)

CREATE TABLE idempotent_mutations (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	request_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	result JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, operation, key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE job_receipts (
	event_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (event_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(event_id) REFERENCES outbox (id)
)

CREATE TABLE notifications (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	body VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	href VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	dedupe_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	read_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (dedupe_key)
)

CREATE TABLE push_subscriptions (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, 
	keys JSON NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (endpoint)
)

CREATE TABLE quest_progress (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	period VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	progress INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, code, period), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE sessions (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	csrf_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	revoked BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE user_badges (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE user_civicdex (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	verified_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, category), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category) REFERENCES categories (code)
)

CREATE TABLE xp_events (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reversal_of VARCHAR(36), 
	rule_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	local_date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	capped BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (idempotency_key), 
	UNIQUE (reversal_of), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reversal_of) REFERENCES xp_events (id)
)

CREATE TABLE action_participants (
	action_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	joined_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	checked_in_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR(36), 
	review_reason VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (action_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(action_id) REFERENCES civic_actions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE authorities (
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	department VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	area_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	category_family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	effective_from VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	effective_to VARCHAR, 
	reviewed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(area_id) REFERENCES administrative_areas (id)
)

CREATE TABLE checkin_challenges (
	action_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	token_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	used BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(action_id) REFERENCES civic_actions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (token_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE oauth_states (
	session_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	state_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	nonce VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	verifier VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	consumed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES sessions (id), 
	UNIQUE (state_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE representatives (
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	area_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_url VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	effective_from VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	effective_to VARCHAR, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(area_id) REFERENCES administrative_areas (id)
)

CREATE TABLE share_cards (
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	action_id VARCHAR(36), 
	object_key VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(action_id) REFERENCES civic_actions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE reports (
	reporter_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	report_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	location geography(POINT,4326) NOT NULL, 
	accuracy_m FLOAT, 
	address VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	area_id VARCHAR(36), 
	authority_id VARCHAR(36), 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	verification VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	severity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	duplicate_of VARCHAR(36), 
	demo BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	finalized_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	resolved_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (report_type in ('place','civic_catch')), 
	CHECK (visibility in ('private','pending','public','restricted','removed')), 
	CHECK (status in ('draft','processing','open','acknowledged','in_progress','resolved','rejected')), 
	CHECK (severity between 1 and 5), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reporter_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category) REFERENCES categories (code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(area_id) REFERENCES administrative_areas (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(authority_id) REFERENCES authorities (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(duplicate_of) REFERENCES reports (id)
)
CREATE INDEX idx_reports_location ON reports USING gist (location)
CREATE INDEX report_public_feed ON reports (visibility, status, created_at)

CREATE TABLE hotspots (
	anchor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	area_id VARCHAR(36), 
	location geography(POINT,4326) NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	score_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (anchor_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(anchor_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(area_id) REFERENCES administrative_areas (id)
)
CREATE INDEX idx_hotspots_location ON hotspots USING gist (location)

CREATE TABLE moderation_cases (
	report_id VARCHAR(36), 
	user_id VARCHAR(36), 
	kind VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	details JSON NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR, 
	closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE report_votes (
	report_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (report_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE resolutions (
	report_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR(36), 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewed_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE verifications (
	report_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	accepted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (report_id, user_id), 
	CHECK (result in ('confirmed','disputed','not_found')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE hotspot_reports (
	report_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	hotspot_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (report_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(hotspot_id) REFERENCES hotspots (id)
)

CREATE TABLE media (
	owner_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	report_id VARCHAR(36), 
	action_id VARCHAR(36), 
	resolution_id VARCHAR(36), 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	original_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	public_key VARCHAR, 
	content_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR, 
	phash VARCHAR, 
	state VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	upload_token_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	upload_expires TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	flags JSON NOT NULL, 
	redacted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	purged_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES reports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(action_id) REFERENCES civic_actions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resolution_id) REFERENCES resolutions (id)
)

CREATE TABLE resolution_verifications (
	resolution_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	accepted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (resolution_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(resolution_id) REFERENCES resolutions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
